Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (attached)

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps as agreed:

- Goal: Reduce per-token inference cost and improve 95th percentile latency for NovaHealth patient triage flows.
- Key stakeholders: Sara (product), Tom (IT/security), Procurement (contracts).
- Proposed pilot: 2-week PoC on anonymized triage set -> measure latency & cost delta.
- Milestones I put in the attached MAP v1:
  1) Share PoC dataset (by customer) — Responsibility: NovaHealth -> Target: 2026-06-17
  2) Environment access & account setup — Responsibility: Redwood (Connor) & NovaHealth IT -> Target: 2026-06-21
  3) PoC run & initial results — Responsibility: Redwood & NovaHealth -> Target: 2026-07-05
  4) Security review & SOC2 evidence exchange — Responsibility: NovaHealth & Redwood -> Target: 2026-06-24
  5) Commercial decision / pilot expansion — Responsibility: Procurement & Product -> Target: 2026-07-15

Attachments: NovaHealth_MAP_v1_20260610.xlsx (MAP draft), NovaHealth_Risk_Assessment_20260612.pdf (security stub).

Ask: Please review the MAP and confirm timelines or flag anything that needs to move. If the dates look good I'd like to sync on the dataset delivery and security contact (Tom?) so Connor can start provisioning.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Quick update from our side: we've had a shift in priorities on the product roadmap — leadership pushed a Q3 regulatory integration ahead of commercial pilots, which affects the procurement timeline. Practical impact:

- Dataset delivery will slip by ~2 weeks (new target: 2026-06-30).
- Security review still high priority; Tom will start compiling evidence but needs an internal kickoff first (Tom: can you confirm a date?).
- Procurement asked to pause signatures until legal sees a revised SOW tied to the regulatory scope; they expect to reconvene the week of 2026-07-12.

We still want to run a slimmed-down PoC if Redwood can scope it without the full dataset (e.g., synthetic / redacted sample). If you can propose a revised MAP that reflects the shifted dates and a contingency for a minimal-scope PoC, we can expedite the security thread.

Cc'ing procurement and Tom.

Best,
Sara
Director of Product | NovaHealth
sara.klein@novahealth.com
